inv.desc_es:
Se vende local acondicionado como vivienda tipo duplex, completamente reformado en 2023 con materiales de alta calidad. Distribuido en dos plantas funcionales y luminosas, ideal para quienes buscan un espacio único con entrada independiente a pie de calle.

Distribución y Características
Planta Baja:
- Amplio comedor integrado
- Cocina completa totalmente equipada
- Baño sencillo de cortesía

Altillo (Planta Superior):
- Acogedora sala de estar
- Habitación doble de gran tamaño
- Baño completo con ducha

inv.desc_en:
Commercial space for sale, converted into a duplex-style home, completely renovated in 2023 with high-quality materials. Distributed over two functional and bright floors, ideal for those looking for a unique space with an independent street-level entrance.

Layout and Features
Ground Floor:
- Spacious integrated dining room
- Fully equipped kitchen
- Simple guest bathroom

Loft (Upper Floor):
- Cozy living room
- Large double bedroom
- Full bathroom with shower

Viewings and Contact? Viewings available: October 21, 22, and 23? Contact: Only via message through Idealista.

If the indicated dates do not work for you, please write to check other availability and find the best time for your visit.

NO AGENCIES.
